notes.title: Mega Pugdate!!
notes.content:
[b]Hello[/b]

Pug'llectors, it is time to announce the [b]first big update[/b]!!

What's new:
[list]
[*] New UI, more updated for smaller resolutions, and easier to select your pugs to change skins! [b]Yey[/b]
[*] New Pugs: 
[olist]
[*]  Pugdates - Our beloved friend
[*]  Tour Pug - Thank you Asanaparada!!
[*]  Pug Artist - Limited Time Skin for this update event!! 
[/olist]
[*] Removed Pugs :
[olist]
[*] Dummy Pug - Our first tester! (no pugs harmed).
[*] Albino Pug - Blue eyes had to go.
[*] Spider Pug - He went back to NYC.
[/olist] 
[*] New Achievements - Related with the new skins, more in the future...
[*] Some game balancing. - this has a possibility to bug your upgrade values! - if you want to reset your save please contact us via discord.
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

Remember Pug'llectors, join discord where you can give suggestions, create Pugs and Backgrounds, and share your playground.

We thank you all for your support, and enjoying the game! Without you, we wouldn't be here!

Let's have them all!!!

notes.title: Patch notes 0.2
notes.content:
[b]Hello[/b]

Pug'llectors, here we're again!

Coming with some news, we did hear your pugrayers...

We also have been hearing you about the game crashes! We believe this is fixed, but if it happens, join discord, and we can talk about it!

New:
[list]
[*] Finally escape that fullscreen mode, and use the scale you want!(alt-enter if you want fullscreen)
[*] Close Pug image in-game updated!
[/list]

We're working on a new UI, in order to be more enjoyable with any resolution that you want to use!

Don't forget to close steam, and reopen to update the game! 

Don't hesitate to contact us in our discord, or through reviews! Everyone is welcomed :D

notes.title: Patch 0.1 Pug One
notes.content:
[b]Hello[/b]

Some rough start! eheh, but we're here Pug'llectors!.

We made some fixes and all saves have been reseted!
Right now you still have your skins / achievements and memory's!

This Update has:
[list]
[*]Fixed a Bug where you could continuously press the background buy button, and loose treats!
[*]Added a save for the sound settings! :)
[*]Fixed the problem with numbers appearing on Treat Counter, that stopped counting.
[/list]

In the work, we have some improvements:
Such as change the resolution and possibility to change to window mode, and leave this infernal fullscreen!
Some events coming, and much more...

We thank everyone who took 1-2 hours of their time to try Pug'llector, and left a review/screenshot.
We want your feedback, and your reviews really are important!

Don't forget to join the Discord, where you can share some ideas and the Pugs you got!

Have a Pug Night!
